office.codeHint: The code the new device shows, like K7QM-4RXT.

office.sideHint: The side the device will serve most.

password.title: Log in

password.newHint: 8 letters or more, not only numbers, and not like your name or phone.

forgot.noEmail: No email? Ask the owner to set you a temporary password, face to face.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.noKey: This link is incomplete. Open it again from the email, or ask for a new one.
reset.done: Your new password is set. Log in with it now.

office.nothingYet: There is nothing in the office you can open here yet.

mySettings.title: My settings
mySettings.intro: They are yours alone, and follow you to every device you log in on.

fonts.second: The second font, easy to read

attendance.failed: Not saved. Try again; if it fails again, tell the manager.

device.name_taken: Another device already has this name.
device.not_active: This device isn't active, so it can't be blocked.

document.maker_unknown: The person who made this record doesn't work at this shop.

staff.temporary_password_open: This person still has a temporary password. This permission waits until they choose their own.

password.must_change: Choose your own password before you go on.

pin.locked: Too many wrong PINs. Try again in {minutes} min.

pin.more_keys: This person has permissions you don't, so you can't set their PIN.

errors.password_too_common: This password is too common. Choose another.
